claim: NVIDIA Jetson Linux guide (r36.5.2, image-based OTA): the OTA payload is ota_payload_package.tar.gz; 'NVIDIA recommends applying a security mechanism, such as a signature or encryption, to this package'; the device must 'Validate the downloaded OTA payload package and its contents according to your own security requirements'; integrators must 'create a complete and secure OTA solution'. No built-in payload signature verification is described. UEFI secure boot payloads need --uefi-keys and --rootfs-uuid; A/B needs --rootfs-b-uuid.

NVIDIA security bulletin (Oct 2025, rev. 1.1 2026-01-14): CVE-2025-33182 (UEFI improper authentication lets a privileged user corrupt the Linux device tree; CVSS 7.6, S:C) on Orin/Xavier and CVE-2025-33177 (NvMap DoS) on Orin/Thor/IGX; fixes ship only as new BSP point releases: 35.6.3, 36.4.7, 38.2.2; delivery via APT server, Download Center or Jetson Linux archive.

RAUC 1.15.2 (2026-03-27) security fix CVE-2026-34155 (GHSA-6hj7-q844-m2hx): 'plain'-format bundles with payload > 2 GiB had an integer overflow so the signature covered only the first few bytes; fixed by rejecting such bundles; verity and crypt formats unaffected.

CVE-2025-62799 (published 2026-02-03): heap buffer overflow in Fast DDS RTPS DATA_FRAG receive path; 'An un authenticated sender can transmit a single malformed RTPS DATA_FRAG packet'; crash and potential RCE; CVSS v4 7.2 (PR:N); fixed in 3.4.1, 3.3.1, 2.6.11.

eProsima/Fast-DDS GitHub security advisories page lists further network-reachable issues published Jul-Sep 2026, among them remote DoS via unchecked sampleSize in DATA_FRAG (GHSA-wv5q-wgv8-qh6v, High), unbounded participant map in SecurityManager (GHSA-mvxp-mfh8-hhv5, High), improper ticket-revocation validation allowing insecure connections (GHSA-7j73-5rxp-jxg2, Critical), and two High issues affecting <= v3.6.1; the first page shows 10 of 4 pages of advisories.

Fast DDS RELEASE_SUPPORT.md: 2.14 (ROS 2 Jazzy's line) LTS, end of standard support September 2026, EOL May 2029; 3.6 LTS standard support to March 2028, EOL May 2031; 3.2 EOL December 2026; 2.6 EOL May 2027; 'support dates may be extended'.

Wiz (2025-07-17) NVIDIAScape CVE-2025-23266, CVSS 9.0: NVIDIA Container Toolkit createContainer hook inherits image env vars, so LD_PRELOAD in a container image gives host root via the privileged enable-cuda-compat hook; affects toolkit <= 1.17.7 and GPU Operator <= 25.3.1; fixed in toolkit 1.17.8; CDI mode affected only before 1.17.5 per Wiz.

k3s docs: --secrets-encryption generates an AES-CBC key in /var/lib/rancher/k3s/server/cred/encryption-config.json (key on disk, not in hardware); 'Secrets-encryption cannot be enabled on an existing server without restarting it'. CLI docs: enabling on a cluster started without the flag is available only from the March 2026 releases v1.33.10+k3s1, v1.34.6+k3s1, v1.35.3+k3s1.

oddlama (2025-01-16): filesystem-confusion attack on automatic TPM2 LUKS unlock (tested on Fedora+clevis and NixOS+systemd-cryptenroll with lanzaboote/Secure Boot): ~10 min physical access; initrd does not verify the LUKS identity of the decrypted volume and a fallback passphrase prompt lets a fake volume run attacker code with TPM access; 'Whether your system is suffers from this issue does not depend on which PCRs you choose'; mitigations: TPM PIN, or measure the volume key into PCR 15 and verify it before running anything from the volume (no proper upstream implementation at the time). Signed PCR 11 policy not analysed. [source: researcher blog]

NVIDIA security bulletin (Feb 2025): CVE-2024-0148 in Jetson UEFI firmware RCM boot mode; unprivileged attacker with physical access; code execution/privilege escalation; CVSS 7.6 (AV:P, S:C); AGX Orin fixed only in Jetson Linux 36.4.3 and 35.6.1; reported by Boston Dynamics; bulletin does not mention fuses or secure boot as a mitigation.
